# cozystack_package_source (Resource)

A Cozystack PackageSource (cluster-scoped, `cozystack.io` group): defines where packages come from and their variants. The spec is a platform document, surfaced as JSON.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cozystack_package_source" "custom" {
  name = "custom.apps"
  spec = jsonencode({
    sourceRef = { kind = "OCIRepository", name = "custom-apps", namespace = "cozy-system" }
    variants  = [{ name = "default" }]
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) PackageSource name (`metadata.name`). Immutable.

### Optional

- `spec` (String) Full PackageSource spec as JSON (`sourceRef`, `variants`).
- `wait_for_ready` (Boolean) Block on create/update until the tenant's `Ready` condition is true.
- `wait_timeout` (String) Maximum time to wait when `wait_for_ready` is set (Go duration, e.g. `10m`).

### Read-Only

- `chart_version` (String) Deployed chart version (`status.version`).
- `id` (String) Object name (cluster-scoped).
- `ready` (Boolean) Whether the application's `Ready` condition is true.
- `uid` (String) Server-assigned object UID (`metadata.uid`). Stable across updates; changes on recreate.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Cluster-scoped: import by name only.
terraform import cozystack_package_source.example name
```
